:::{#exm-derivation}
#### A derivation with equalities and inequalities

For every real number $x$:

$$
\ba
(x + 1)^2
&= x^2 + 2x + 1
&& \text{(square of a sum)}
\\
&\ge 2x + 1
&& \text{(} x^2 \ge 0 \text{)}
\\
&> 2x
&& \text{(} 1 > 0 \text{)}
\ea
$$

The first step uses the [square of a sum](algebra.qmd#thm-square-of-a-sum).
The steps are $=$, $\ge$, and $>$,
so the derivation shows $(x + 1)^2 > 2x$.
For example, with $x = 3$: $(3 + 1)^2 = 16$, and $16 > 6 = 2 \cd 3$.

:::
